verdict.rationale: An app marketplace of prebuilt integrations is a fair question for a CRM/SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a HubSpot app marketplace or one-click installs for Slack, support desk, marketing or data-warehouse apps. What it does contain doesn't count: developer building blocks (APIs, webhooks, CLI, MCP servers, developer test accounts) and an adjacent feature (connecting an individual inbox).
